items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Teddy Phillips--did you know Teddy Phillips from Chicago?

ctx.x: on the Plains, like in the television series, and some way he went to the University of Chicago and some way or other, I guess as a kid in school, he started a hotel band, a little society band and I don't know, I've never heard how he got into the jazz business, but I do know that in those days, during the war, during the excitement of the war, an awful lot of people who had hotel bands and tenor bands and nondescript commercial operations, decided they wanted to become jazz people.
Teddy Phillips--did you know Teddy Phillips from Chicago?
